OpenComposite (OpenVR -> OpenXR), the two DLLs next to this file in bin\: vrclient.dll (32-bit) and vrclient_x64.dll (64-bit).

Project:   OpenComposite for AirFrameXR, https://github.com/jfbobier/airframexr-opencomposite (AirFrameXR's fork of
           OpenComposite, https://gitlab.com/znixian/OpenOVR, branch openxr; an independent fork, not affiliated with that project)
License:   GNU General Public License, version 3 or later: docs\licenses\OpenComposite-LICENSE.txt
           (it also contains Valve's OpenVR headers, MIT/BSD: docs\licenses\OpenComposite-OpenVR-headers-LICENSE.txt,
            inih, BSD: docs\licenses\OpenComposite-inih-LICENSE.txt, and the OpenXR SDK, Apache-2.0)
Version:   693b670fc9f936d9c7891d912a2cd5fd66e9a983
           (release v1.0, "OpenComposite for AirFrameXR 1.0", 2026-11-28; the DLLs print the revision airframexr-693b670 at start):
           upstream openxr at cff07db, its pending merge requests !185 !186 !188 !189 !190 !191 !192 and !114 (bounded),
           and AirFrameXR's fixes (D3D11/D3D12 float formats and flipped bounds, background OpenVR clients, the D3D adapter)
Binaries:  built by AirFrameXR from that commit (Visual Studio 2022, Release, whole-program optimisation, target OCOVR), as published on
           https://github.com/jfbobier/airframexr-opencomposite/releases/tag/v1.0
           vrclient.dll        sha256 23ee03f405cc3a93765bfbe8b2a86fca4497a72d097a3c361bd9e1c39469eaf6
           vrclient_x64.dll    sha256 e26d5fc6236ae1b2875e002e87fde834d65b265a898dd297cb67df2bd2826206

Corresponding source (GPL-3.0 section 6): OpenOVR-693b670fc9f936d9c7891d912a2cd5fd66e9a983.tar.gz in this folder: that commit with the OpenXR SDK and glm submodules it
pins (the release's airframexr-opencomposite-1.0-source.tar.gz, renamed), also at https://github.com/jfbobier/airframexr-opencomposite
           sha256 dbaf214621ffb323c8d2660293690f5850a74e4635fba35f50326b370e84c0ca

AirFrameXR does not link to these DLLs. It copies nothing into a game: the launcher's OpenVR line only points the system-wide
OpenVR runtime path (%LOCALAPPDATA%\openvr\openvrpaths.vrpath) at this folder, or back at SteamVR. OpenVR games then load these DLLs, which translate
OpenVR into OpenXR for the active OpenXR runtime (AirFrameXR). Deleting this folder removes OpenComposite.
